theorem.name: CONSTHiggs01H4NonlinearSourceRuleCutsetTheorem
theorem.statement: H4 evaluates the nonlinear Higgs self-interaction source rule against the current corpus and proof repos. The strict quartic target is not emitted. The gate is reduced to a two-object cutset: first, unpatched physical action ownership of the finite trace/C1 kernel or an independent residual-projector-independent Hessian/quadrature source; second, a selected Higgs-amplitude projection extracting the |phi|^4 self-interaction slot. Existing support gives H3 quadratic stiffness, source-identity normal form, 72-row slot coverage, and one exact first-row value, but not strict nonlinear Higgs quartic closure.
